picks.bear: Thin trading and coverage; small-cap pharma can swing 20% on one headline. GAAP profit was boosted by a one-time tax benefit.

picks.name: Eton Pharmaceuticals

picks.bear: Fell about 25% in one day during the AI sell-off. Zacks itself calls it the most speculative of its AI picks, citing size and export risks.

picks.social: Some retail interest in optical AI plays.
picks.thesis: Makes indium phosphide substrates for AI data-center optics. Q3 revenue rose 162% to a record $73.4M and backlog tops $500M. Zacks ranks it Strong Buy.

regime.label: Risk-off
regime.note: The Nasdaq fell 3.4% and the S&P 500 2.7% last week, their worst week since June. Chip stocks fell about 11-12% on Thursday on worries that Democratic midterm gains could slow data-center construction. October payrolls beat at 165,000, and futures price about an 80% chance of a December Fed hike. This week: CPI Tuesday, PPI Friday, and earnings from CoreWeave, Cisco and Applied Materials. Nvidia fell premarket Monday on a board probe.
